announcement.quote: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. to Acquire Alcentra Capital Corporation

outcome_evidence.quote: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. (“Crescent BDC”) today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Alcentra Capital Corporation (“Alcentra Capital”)

deals.notes: Target is shown as listed (NASDAQ:ABDC, 8-K 0001193125-20-019114). The acquirer's exchange listing is not shown at announcement: the 2020-02-03 release speaks of fee waivers 'for 18 months following listing' and the first excerpt showing '(NASDAQ: CCAP)' is the 2020-03-04 release, after the merger. So both_listed is null (settled neither way by the excerpts). Stockholder approval of both sides announced 2020-01-30. The structure was multi-step (reincorporation merger of the acquirer in Maryland plus the acquisition), but the 2020-02-03 release states the acquisition was completed.

problems: both_listed left null because Crescent BDC's own listing status at the time of the deal is not stated in the excerpts.
